title: Identification of biomarkers related to propionate metabolism in schizophrenia.
authors: Xie, Weiqi; Luo, Zhihong; Xiao, Jiang; Zhang, Xuehua; Zhang, Chanjuan; Yang, Ping; Li, Liang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过机器学习筛选精神分裂症中丙酸代谢相关生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子调控网络，但核心是疾病诊断标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a severe mental disorder with complex etiology. Research shows propionate metabolism is crucial for neurological function and health. This suggests abnormalities in propionate metabolism may link to SCZ. Therefore, identifying biomarkers associated with propionate metabolism might be beneficial for the diagnosis and treatment of SCZ patients. METHODS: SCZ datasets and propionate metabolism-related genes (PMRGs) from public databases were obtained. DE-PMRGs were identified through differential and correlation analysis of PMRGs. Machine learning was used to screen for key genes and validate expression levels, aiming to identify potential biomarkers. Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) and immune infiltration analysis were performed on the biomarkers. An upstream regulatory network was constructed, and potential drugs targeting these biomarkers were explored. Finally, real-time fluorescence quantitative PCR (qPCR) was used to verify biomarker expression levels. RESULT: A total of 11 DE-PMRGs were identified, and machine learning technology was employed to further screen for 5 key genes. Among these, LY96 and TMEM123 emerged as potential biomarkers through expression verification. A diagnostic model was developed, achieving an area under the curve (AUC) greater than 0.7, which indicates strong diagnostic performance. Additionally, nomograms based on these biomarkers demonstrated promising predictive capabilities in assessing the risk of SCZ. To explore gene functions and regulatory mechanisms at a deeper level, a competitive endogenous RNA (ceRNA) regulatory network was constructed, including 2 biomarkers, 72 microRNAs, and 202 long non-coding RNAs. In addition, a regulatory network containing 2 biomarkers and 104 transcription factors (TFs) was also established to investigate the transcription factors interacting with the biomarkers. Potential biomarker-targeted drugs were identified by exploring the DrugBank database; notably, LY96 exhibited higher binding affinities for four drugs, with docking scores consistently below-5 kcal/mol. The qPCR results indicated that the expression levels of LY96 and TMEM123 in the whole blood of SCZ patients were significantly higher than those in the healthy control group, which was consistent with the results in the GSE38484 and GSE27383 datasets. CONCLUSION: This study identified disease diagnostic biomarkers associated with propionate metabolism in SCZ, specifically LY96 and TMEM123. These findings offer novel perspectives for the diagnosis and management of SCZ.
abstract_zh: 目的：精神分裂症（SCZ）是一种病因复杂的严重精神障碍。研究表明，丙酸代谢对神经功能与健康至关重要，提示丙酸代谢异常可能与SCZ相关。因此，识别与丙酸代谢相关的生物标志物可能有助于SCZ患者的诊断和治疗。方法：从公共数据库获取SCZ数据集及丙酸代谢相关基因（PMRGs）。通过差异分析和相关性分析鉴定DE-PMRGs。利用机器学习筛选关键基因并验证表达水平，旨在识别潜在生物标志物。对生物标志物进行基因集富集分析（GSEA）和免疫浸润分析。构建上游调控网络，并探索靶向这些生物标志物的潜在药物。最后，采用实时荧光定量PCR（qPCR）验证生物标志物表达水平。结果：共鉴定出11个DE-PMRGs，并运用机器学习技术进一步筛选出5个关键基因。其中，通过表达验证，LY96和TMEM123成为潜在生物标志物。构建的诊断模型曲线下面积（AUC）大于0.7，表明其具有较强诊断性能。此外，基于这些生物标志物的列线图在评估SCZ风险方面展现出良好的预测能力。为更深入探索基因功能和调控机制，构建了竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）调控网络，包含2个生物标志物、72个微小RNA和202个长链非编码RNA。同时，还建立了包含2个生物标志物和104个转录因子（TFs）的调控网络，以研究与之相互作用的转录因子。通过探索DrugBank数据库识别潜在靶向生物标志物的药物；值得注意的是，LY96对四种药物表现出较高结合亲和力，对接分数均低于-5 kcal/mol。qPCR结果显示，SCZ患者全血中LY96和TMEM123的表达水平显著高于健康对照组，这与GSE38484和GSE27383数据集中的结果一致。结论：本研究识别了SCZ中与丙酸代谢相关的疾病诊断生物标志物，即LY96和TMEM123。这些发现为SCZ的诊断和管理提供了新视角。
